d:
Amerika men 3 navanbar ko midtarm chunav ke lie voting hogi. is chunav men rashtrapti donald tranp ki ripablikan parti ki taqat ki pariksha hogi. agar ripablikan parti ameriki kangres ke donon sadnon men bahumat ganva deti hai, to tranp ke lie apne ejende ko aage barhana mushkil ho sakta hai.
Bharat ki nazar bhi in chunavon par hai. tairif, H-1B viza, rus se tel kharidne aur pakistan ke sath amerika ki barhti nazdiki jaise muddon par chunav ke natijon ka kya asar par sakta hai? samjha rahe hain bibisi nyuz hindi ke editar nitin shrivastav.
